description:
High school student Ookoshi discovers the secret of his well-endowed classmate, Takitait turns out that Takita does not have the breasts that everyone around her believes her to have. Fearing that Ookoshi may expose her secret, Takita "gives" him something irresistible as an incentive.
Source: hentaini
